name: hDelta-fastW-continual-nav
claim: Online fast weights on hDeltaH/A/I/G outgoing synapses are necessary to remap a context→goal heading. After learning context A (left landmark), freezing those weights causes failure on context B (right landmark); keeping them plastic remaps.
falsifier: Clamping or silencing hDeltaH/A/I/G synaptic plasticity (or the cells) in real flies should prevent reversing a learned heading goal when the rewarded landmark switches, while leaving first-context heading largely intact. PFL3 laterality is the readout, not a new motor neuron.
readout: hDelta → PFL3 (real Male CNS edges; 261 synapses from all 45 plastic cells). Assay steering mixes MN tank-steer with fast-weight-decoded PFL3 laterality. NeuroMechFly is not closed.
not_this_experiment: Does not reopen CVA-SST Exp0/Exp1 or M1–M3.
